snippet.title: Ethereal Odyssey - Trailer
snippet.description:
A lost boy awakens. The world around him shifts, twisting between the real and the imagined.
Step into a 2D Metroidvania full of hidden paths, mysterious creatures, and dreams waiting to be explored.
